name: Captain Vimes
summary: Near Theramore, Lieutenant Aden sends you to Captain Garran Vimes with an orc report and word of Horde spies.

sections.title: A Report for the Captain
sections.body: Lieutenant Aden sends you to Captain Garran Vimes with the orc report you found. Vimes reads orcish better than most, so Aden wants him to know that Horde spies are close to Theramore. You’ll find Vimes at the barracks on the northeastern side of Theramore Isle.

faq.q: Who sends you to Captain Vimes?
aliases: where do i get captain vimes
faq.answer: Lieutenant Aden sends you, hoping Captain Vimes will read the orc report you found.

faq.q: Where is Captain Garran Vimes located?
faq.answer: Captain Garran Vimes is at the barracks on Theramore Isle’s northeastern side.

faq.q: Why does Captain Vimes need to see the report?
aliases: why does vimes need the report
faq.answer: Aden says Vimes reads orcish better than most. He wants Vimes to hear that Horde spies are close to Theramore.
